description:
IOP Publishing's legacy journal class iopart.cls ('1996/06/10 v0.0 IOP Journals LaTeX article class', LPPL, maintained by IOP Publishing Ltd) with its size file iopart12.clo (1997/01/15 v1.0). Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror (MiKTeX has only iopart-num.bst): both files are from ioplatexguidelines.zip on publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org (wp-content/uploads/2024/03; the 2022 and 2017 copies are byte-identical), the bundle of IOP's 'Author guidelines for IOP Publishing journals in LaTeX'. IOP's current template is iopjournal (its own setting); iopart is the class most older IOP papers on arXiv use. 12pt is the option the guidelines' own document uses (IOPLaTeXGuidelines.tex l.42; [10pt] only for two columns, l.89); iopart maps it to iopart12.clo, so iopart10.clo is not shipped. Paper stays the class default, letterpaper. Three preamble lines. (1) iopart defines equation* and endequation* (iopart.cls l.788-789, \@namedef{equation*}{\[}), so General's amsmath, which declares equation* with 
ewenvironment, would stop at 'Command \equation* already defined'; the guidelines call the amsmath clash one that cannot be completely worked around (l.151). The line removes both names before amsmath loads, so amsmath's equation and equation* replace iopart's. (2) iopart's 	itle and \author typeset at once (l.106-116, l.225-237: \vspace*, a bold paragraph in the 'indented' list), and its \maketitle only ends the page (l.98; the template uses it only 'if a separate title page is required', l.86-87). Given in the preamble they would start a paragraph before  egin{document}. The line keeps a preamble 	itle[short]{full} or \author[short]{list} until \maketitle and runs iopart's own command there, and leaves both as iopart has them after  egin{document} (the \document=\@notprerr test asmejour's \author uses); \maketitle then prints the kept title block and does not start a new page, which is what General's \maketitle asks for. (3) iopart sets the author list as one item of its 'indented' list, where the kernel's \and (\end{tabular}\hskip... egin{tabular}) would stop at ' egin{indented} ended by \end{tabular}'; \and becomes a comma, as in the template's own author lines. iopart.cls has LF line ends, but iopart12.clo uses bare CR line ends (old Mac format). iopart numbers footnotes with \@fnsymbol, which has nine symbols ('Counter too large' from the tenth footnote, round b28: 1,841 branches); from the tenth on, footnotes get arabic numbers (probe B3B-iopart-footnotes-new: 14 errors before, 0 after). iopart defines no 
ewblock, which BibTeX styles write between a reference's blocks ('Command 
ewblock undefined', round b28: 217 branches); it becomes a space (probe B3B-iopart-newblock-new: bibtex, no undefined citations).
